attribute_descriptions.activities: Activity is a piece of work that forms one logical step within a process. That activity could be subdivided into several keystrokes, therefore on average it would contain up to 10 keystrokes. The Activity is done in a single application
attribute_descriptions.business_rules: Number of conditional logic branches or decision rules. Business Rule which results in creation of additional flow
attribute_descriptions.layouts: Number of distinct UI screens or forms the bot interacts with. Any different input/output file should be treated as separate layouts.
attribute_descriptions.interfaces: Number of external system integrations (APIs, databases, applications). Target application used by the business to perform daily duties, any application/interface should be considered separately
attribute_descriptions.technology: Number of technology integration points required for the automation. Requirement of surface automation/Citrix, web services or API to be developed

metadata.description: Weight assignment for each attribute-tier combination with tier definitions
